description: One soft tan feather, barbs still perfect. It came off something that flies, which narrows it down little.
lore: Six gold, and it takes something like four hundred to fill a bolster. Three of the four rooms at [[lore/the_long_table|the Long Table]] are shut, and in one of them a bolster has been getting fatter for years, a handful at a time, by whoever is passing, with nobody organising it. It is not for anyone in particular. It is the bed a person would be put in, if a person came, and it is ready.
gm_notes: The shut rooms, kept ready by no one in charge. Warmth, not mystery: there is no answer to who it is for, and asking is the scene.
